full_name: Tiffany N. Florvil | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 History Joy Foundation Fellow University of New Mexico
bio: Tiffany N. Florvil is an associate professor of history at the University of New Mexico and a 20th century cultural historian of Germany whose work focuses on African/Black diasporic communities, internationalism, race, gender, and sexuality.
